claims.evidence: Witness report describes the chair but does not mention it being bent.
Photos show only an indoor room; location cannot be confirmed from the report.
Age or usage history is listed as not shown in the report.
Report does not address stains on the chair.
Report lists hidden tears or wear on mesh or padding as not shown.
Report cannot show whether foam is firm.

risks.risk: Height adjustment lever may not work.
risks.proof: Video of the lever raising and lowering the seat.

risks.risk: Recline or tilt mechanism may not work.
risks.proof: Clip of the chair tilting and locking in recline.
Video of the chair rolling across the floor.

risks.risk: Footrest may not extend and lock properly.
risks.proof: Clip of the footrest extending and locking.

risks.risk: Hidden tears or wear on mesh or padding.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the mesh, armrest padding, and seat underside.

risks.risk: Age or usage history may be greater than claimed.
risks.proof: Purchase receipt or dated photos showing condition consistent with one year of use.
risks.if_unproven: as older or more heavily used.

proof_requests: Video showing height adjustment, recline/tilt, casters rolling, and footrest extending and locking.
Close-up photos of the mesh and padding to check for tears or wear.
Proof of purchase to verify the 'bought new last year' claim.
response.reason: The witness identified the item as an office chair with footrest, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition despite unverified seller claims.
